about: Figures for the tables of the third random starting point (seed 2), read by Step 116.
No file of a run holds these figures. The earlier steps only printed them.
They were copied by hand from the accepted outputs of those steps. Each entry names the step and the output line it came from.
Memory figures are sampled once per second and are not exact peaks. GPU memory is that of the whole card.
